La Très Ancienne et Sérénissime Maison de Valebasse

Plate I · The founding imagery

The Realm was fully illustrated before it was properly governed.

This original identity plate contains the visual vocabulary of Valebasse: its peacock and parrot supporters, quartered notification shield, algorithmic appointment seal, notification emblem, royal standard, Wi-Fi crown, and ceremonial typography. These elements are a library—not a requirement that every garment display all of them.

Distinctions of the Realm

Honors may be earned through purchase, persistence, or administrative error.

  • Order of JacquardFor programmable weaving and other ancestral instructions nobody read
  • Order of the Blue CheckDistinguished service to personal visibility
  • Baron of BufferingFor patience under uncertain loading conditions
  • Viscount of VaguepostingFor saying enough to invite inquiry, but never enough to clarify
  • Duke of DoomscrollingFor exhaustive research into the deterioration of everything
